page.notes: The drop-cap H is an ornamented woodcut initial; the letters HUC are joined to it. The Greek word Διαταγῆς is split across the line end as Διατα- / γῆς; the second letter group is uncertain and marked [?]. The printed text is partly unclear at the paper edge on the left. The right side of the scan shows a binding and a finger, which are left out.
